title: Keys and Doors
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about keys and doors. A key adds to a counter, and a locked door opens when the counter is high enough. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and move a key or lock a new door.

box.tagline: Some doors do not open just because you ask nicely.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has locked doors to get through. Keys are lying around: a gold one, a silver one, and a ledge to climb. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a door.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Keys add to a counter, doors spend it
Made to be copied and taken apart
